claims.text: Alberta Invites 425 Workers in Five Provincial Immigration Draws
claims.llm_reason: The article states Alberta invited 425 workers in five draws.

claims.text: The Alberta Advantage Immigration Program issued 425 invitations across five draws between October 23 and November 2, led by the Rural Renewal Stream — but only 495 of the province's 6,603 nomination spaces for 2026 remain.
claims.llm_reason: All facts about invitations, dates, and nomination spaces are present in the article.

claims.text: Alberta issued 425 invitations to apply for provincial nomination across five AAIP draws held between October 23 and November 2, with minimum scores between 50 and 60
claims.llm_reason: The article confirms the number of invitations and the date range with score details.

claims.text: The Rural Renewal Stream accounted for 210 of the invitations; the Alberta Opportunity Stream issued 132 and the two Dedicated Health Care Pathway draws issued 83 combined
claims.llm_reason: The article provides exact numbers for each stream's invitations.

claims.text: Alberta had issued 6,108 of its 6,603 nominations for 2026 as of November 4, leaving 495 spaces, with 32,211 candidates still active in the expression-of-interest pool
claims.llm_reason: All statistics regarding nominations and candidates are accurately reported in the article.
